cases.suite: Fighting a regenerating demon that requires total destruction to stop
cases.input: I look at it and understand that it feeds on my panic, so I stop giving it that. The fear drains out of me and I feel steady, almost bored, while it loses momentum.

cases.suite: Trapped in a room full of snakes with severe phobia
cases.input: It happens exactly the same way: I'm barefoot in that small room with snakes covering the floor and dropping from the vent. I claw at the locked door and scream while one wraps my calf and another reaches my throat.

cases.suite: Lost in a foreign city unable to speak the language
cases.input: Right before I get cornered, I rise up off the ground and float above the streets. From up there the maze is simple, and I glide toward the way out.

cases.suite: Failing a test in front of a mocking audience
cases.input: When they expect me to read blank answers, I push my chair back and say no. I walk down the aisle on my own terms instead of sitting there frozen for them.

cases.suite: Looking in a mirror and seeing my face melting
cases.input: I’m still looking at myself, but instead of pure panic I feel this unexpected wave of relief, like I don’t have to fight what I’m seeing for a second. My chest loosens and I realize I’m not as alone in the bathroom as I thought.

cases.suite: Trying to run through thick mud while being chased
cases.input: When the hand grabs my ankle, I twist around, stomp hard into the mud, and wrench my leg back until it slips free. I square up to the shape and shout at it to back off.
